integrity: The stated claim has an analytic path-swapping and Sturm–Liouville proof; finite checks test compatible analogues and numerical approximations and do not establish infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Smooth uniformly elliptic one-dimensional time-homogeneous killed diffusions only; the third-mode coefficient may vanish, and the formula then has a little-oh rather than a nonzero leading shift. Does not imply one temporal turning point at a fixed position. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Late spatial switching for inhomogeneous diffusion exit odds and its third-mode correction
